input: Find 4-H and Cooperative Extension summer camps and day camps (each county) for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Buncombe County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun day camps covered cooking, agriculture, world cultures and art.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Henderson County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 F.R.E.S.H. offered five weeks of goat care and public service for ages 11–17; also advertised a Fletcher horsemanship clinic.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Haywood County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 programs included sewing, crochet, electricity, cooking, evening crafts and an archery clinic, for ages 8 and up depending on session.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Madison County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun offered cooking, sewing, animal science, creek ecology and horseback riding for ages 5–18.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Transylvania County 4-H
candidates.note: Advertised Summer Fun registration and supervised summer enrichment activities for 2025.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Yancey County 4-H
candidates.note: Offered a series of Summer Fun youth learning programs in 2025.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Mitchell County 4-H
candidates.note: Offered 2026 Summer Fun camps with in-person registration at the county Extension center.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — McDowell County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Discovery included youth activities and supervised trips; 4-H enrollment required.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Polk County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 offerings included livestock and equine care, youth canning and summer pop-up activities; a Cloverbud camp was listed for June 2026.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Rutherford County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun consisted of youth educational workshops, tours and hands-on activities.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Jackson County 4-H
candidates.note: July 2026 two-session STEM evening program introduced robotics and programming for ages 8–18.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Swain County 4-H
candidates.note: Listed Fun with 4-H at recreation camp in July and August 2026.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Burke County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included a three-day sewing camp for ages 10–18 and a Safe Sitter/CPR workshop for ages 10–14.
